title: KernelArmor: End-to-End Agentic System for Establishing Memory and Thread Safety for CUDA
abstract: arXiv:2611.18754v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Optimized CUDA kernels can pass testing while retaining subtle memory and concurrency bugs. We present KernelArmor, an agentic framework that combines LLM-generated annotations with an extended SMT verifier to establish memory and thread safety under explicit contracts. KernelArmor can reason about kernels with advanced CUDA features, such as tensor cores, packed accesses, warp synchronization, asynchronous copies, and library calls, returning source-level diagnostics to guide verification and repair. Across 740 instances containing 1,370 production-grade CUDA kernels, it reports potential bugs in 78.6% of instances and establishes safety for 11.4%, outperforming the evaluated state-of-the-art tools in detection coverage, identifying 100% of cuCatch memory-safety bugs and all in-scope cuHadron races. translated_title: KernelArmor：为CUDA建立内存与线程安全的端到端智能体系统
translated_abstract: 经过优化的CUDA内核即使通过了测试，仍可能隐藏微妙的内存和并发错误。我们提出KernelArmor，这是一个智能体框架，它将LLM生成的注释与扩展的SMT验证器相结合，在显式契约下建立内存和线程安全保证。KernelArmor能够对使用高级CUDA特性的内核进行推理，例如张量核心、打包访问、warp同步、异步拷贝和库调用，并返回源代码级别的诊断信息以指导验证与修复。在包含1,370个生产级CUDA内核的740个实例中，它在78.6%的实例中报告了潜在错误，并为11.4%的实例建立了安全证明，在检测覆盖率上超越了所评估的最先进工具，识别出100%的cuCatch内存安全错误以及全部在范围内的cuHadron竞争条件。集成到智能体优化循环中后，KernelArmor在全部77个轨迹中生成了经过验证的内核，同时保留了99%的未（原文在此截断）
tldr: KernelArmor是一个将LLM生成注释与扩展SMT验证器相结合的智能体框架，能够在显式契约下为使用张量核心等高级特性的CUDA内核建立内存与线程安全保证，并在智能体优化循环中生成经验证的内核。
en_tdlr: KernelArmor is an agentic framework combining LLM-generated annotations with an extended SMT verifier to establish memory and thread safety for CUDA kernels with advanced features under explicit contracts, and produces verified kernels within an agentic optimization loop.
